C0173.title: CV-Inspector: Towards Automating Detection of Adblock Circumvention
C0173.summary: The CV-INSPECTOR study proposes an automated method for detecting adblock circumvention services. It analyzes differences in page execution when an adblocker is enabled or disabled to identify whether a site deploys anti-adblock logic. The paper reports about 93% accuracy on labeled data and applies the method to measure the top 20,000 websites, aiming to help the adblock community find circumvention sites and maintain filter rules at scale.
